title: Real-time virtual circuits for plasma shape control via neural network emulators: integration and testing in the MAST-U PCS
abstract: arXiv:2608.26216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The deployment of advanced, AI-enabled control algorithms in tokamak experiments requires robust integration with existing plasma control system (PCS) architectures and extensive pre-experimental validation. In this contribution, we describe the integration and testing of neural-network-emulated virtual circuits for plasma shape control within the MAST Upgrade (MAST-U) PCS environment. The neural network models predict the plasma shape using the plasma current, poloidal field coil currents, and plasma profile parameters. In this paper, we explain how they are deployed via a real-time C++ inference server that interfaces with the PCS, returning the shape prediction and its Jacobian, and how, from the latter, virtual circuit matrices and updated coil current requests are computed for real-time actuation. translated_title: 基于神经网络模拟器的等离子体形状控制实时虚拟电路：在MAST-U PCS中的集成与测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26216v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在托卡马克实验中部署先进的AI增强控制算法，需要与现有等离子体控制系统（PCS）架构进行稳健集成，并进行广泛的实验前验证。本文描述了在MAST升级（MAST-U）PCS环境中，用于等离子体形状控制的神经网络模拟虚拟电路的集成与测试过程。神经网络模型利用等离子体电流、极向场线圈电流和等离子体轮廓参数来预测等离子体形状。我们解释了如何通过实时C++推理服务器部署这些模型，该服务器与PCS接口，返回形状预测及其雅可比矩阵，并说明如何从后者计算虚拟电路矩阵和更新的线圈电流请求，以实现实时驱动。重点强调了验证工作流程和最佳实践，以确保在实验前对所提出的控制框架建立信心。
tldr: 本文介绍了在MAST-U等离子体控制系统中集成和测试基于神经网络的实时虚拟电路，用于通过预测形状和雅可比矩阵实现等离子体形状控制，并强调了实验前的验证流程。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the integration and testing of real-time neural-network-based virtual circuits in the MAST-U plasma control system for plasma shape control, using shape and Jacobian predictions, with emphasis on pre-experimental validation workflows.
